newsitem.title: USA: US CORPORATE BONDS - Deals emerge after Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: US CORPORATE BONDS - Deals emerge after Greenspan.

text.p: Corporate debt underwriters busied themselves structuring deals for opportunistic issuers Wednesday after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan erased market fears of a near-term Fed tightening, leaving a window of opportunity for issuers to finance debt, dealers said.
"New issues have dominated the session ... issuers want to take advantage of the market rally," said one high-grade trader. "Unfortunately, secondary activity has stayed rather quiet."
Greenspan finished his two-day Humphrey Hawkins testimony with remarks to the Senate Wednesday.
